identity.mission: Create a unique, high-contrast, dark-mode tourism analytics system that breaks the mold of generic dashboards.

headings.usage: All section titles, hero text, and card headers.

body.usage: Paragraphs, data tables, and UI controls.

mono.usage: Code snippets, API keys, and specific data metrics.

customization.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp edges, high contrast on hover.
customization.cards: Flat background (#1e293b), 1px border (#334155), no shadow by default, subtle shadow on hover.
customization.inputs: Dark background (#0f172a), light border (#334155), focus ring cyan.
customization.charts: Recharts with custom tooltips and responsive containers.
customization.maps: React Leaflet with custom dark tile layer (CartoDB Dark Matter).

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly for overlays and sticky headers: bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Subtle gradients only for accents or text highlights. No full-screen gradients.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Colored shadows for neon effect on active elements: shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(6,182,212,0.3)].
visual_enhancers.icons: Lucide React (default) or Phosphor Icons for a more technical look.

instructions_to_main_agent.general: You are building a high-performance, dark-mode tourism analytics dashboard. Prioritize data visibility and smooth interactions.

frontend.maps: Use 'react-leaflet' with 'leaflet' CSS. Mock the map data points.
frontend.charts: Use 'recharts' for all data visualization. Style them to match the dark theme.

testing.attributes: Add data-testid to all interactive elements.

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts.
Create depth through layered design elements.
Use glassmorphism effects with backdrop filters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures and noise overlays are encouraged.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters.
